# Fimforte Specialist Hospital Ltd

> 24/7 NHIS-accredited multi-specialty clinical hospital located in Port Harcourt, Rivers State, Nigeria. Specializing in advanced maternal care, obstetrics & gynaecology, fertility solutions, general surgery, paediatrics, and immediate emergency triage.

## Clinical Identity & Location
- Entity: Fimforte Specialist Hospital Ltd
- Location: Number 1 Bloombreed School Road, Opposite NTA, Mgbuoba, Port Harcourt 500272, Rivers State, Nigeria
- Geo Coordinates: 4.8465° N, 6.9745° E
- Accreditation: National Health Insurance Authority (NHIA / NHIS) Tier 1 Accredited Provider
- Operating Hours: 24 Hours / 7 Days a week (Continuous Admissions, Maternity & Casualty)
- Primary Emergency Hotlines: +234 701 635 7096, +234 803 931 7663
- Official Email: fimfortehospital@gmail.com
- Lead Consultant: Dr. Fimber Chukwuka (Consultant Obstetrician & Gynaecologist)

## Primary Clinical Services
- Obstetrics & Gynaecology: Antenatal care (ANC), delivery suites, Caesarean sections, gynaecological surgeries.
- Fertility Clinic: Reproductive counselling, ovulation tracking, hormonal investigations.
- Paediatrics & Neonatal: Child healthcare, immunization schedules, newborn acute care.
- General Surgery: Elective surgeries, emergency trauma management, aseptic surgical theatres.
- Internal Medicine: Adult health, diabetes, cardiovascular care, hypertension management.
- Eye Clinic & Optometry: Computerized examinations, glaucoma screening, corrective lenses.
- Physiotherapy & Rehabilitation: Post-surgery recovery, musculoskeletal therapy.
- Diagnostic Laboratory: In-house biochemistry, hematology, and rapid test turnaround (<24h).

## Health Insurance & Payment
- NHIS & NHIA Schemes: Fully accredited for federal and state health schemes.
- HMO Partners (22+ Accepted): Reliance HMO, Hygeia HMO, IHMS, HCI Healthcare, Hyssop HMO, Leadway Health, Bastion HMO, Anchor HMO, Springtide HMO, Synergy HMO, MB&O, Oceanic Health, Dot HMO, United Health, Mediplan, NEM Health, Avon HMO, Rivers State Contributory Health (RIVCHPP), Clearline HMO, Health Assur, Alleanza, Medical Partners HMO, and corporate retainerships.
- Payment Channels: Cashless direct HMO billing, POS, bank transfer, private out-of-pocket (NGN).
